mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a strengthening labor market, which is associated with higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above its 3-month moving average, the combination signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% AND INDPRO > 3-month MA, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 and annualized GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and tightening monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 AND GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 280.0 signals persistent inflation, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 280.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) above its 2017 base level (100) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals expanding economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals sustained economic expansion and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 149,000 and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100, the combination signals a robust economy with strong labor and production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 149000 AND INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
